info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Savings Account Details API
info.description: The Savings Account Details API facilitates the retrieval of comprehensive information on specific savings accounts. By utilizing a unique account identifier, users can access essential data such as balance, transaction history, and account status. This API is primarily aimed at banking applications and financial services platforms that require up-to-date information for account management and customer support purposes. Developers can leverage this API to enhance user experiences by providing detailed insights into their savings accounts.

get.summary: Retrieve details for a specific savings account.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific savings account using its unique account identifier. It provides essential data regarding account balance, transaction history, and account holder information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve details for the savings account with the identifier ACC-200045. Ensure that the necessary parameters are included in the request to obtain accurate account information.

200.description: Successful retrieval of savings account details.

GetSavingsAccountByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for a GET operation on a savings account. It is currently defined as a simple string.

GetSavingsAccountByIdResponse_200.title: Savings Account Response

customerId.description: The unique identifier for the customer.

accountId.description: The unique identifier for the savings account.

productCode.description: The code representing the product associated with the account.

principal.description: The principal amount of the savings account.

repaymentFrequency.description: The frequency of repayment for the account.

accountPurpose.description: The intended purpose of the savings account.

statementFrequency.description: The frequency at which statements are generated for the account.

overdraftAllowed.description: Indicates whether overdraft is allowed on the savings account.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of the last update to the savings account.
